name: SJTU MR wire drive
full_name: SJTU pneumatic MR-conditional guidewire delivery mechanism with decoupled actuation
group: Shanghai Jiao Tong University, Institute of Medical Robotics (Anzhu Gao, Guang-Zhong Yang; Shaoping Huang) with Empa
rotation_detail: other: pneumatic slip ring rotates the whole wheel unit, driven by a rotary pneumatic step motor through 1:5 spur gears
imaging_compat: MR-conditional: pneumatic step motors, 3D-printed parts; tested in a Siemens MAGNETOM Aera 1.5 T
validation_detail: real-time MRI-guided guidewire delivery in an aorta phantom (TRANDOMED SJK001F) (huang2022_pneumatic Sec. IV-C)
key_numbers: resolution 0.238 mm/step and 0.4 deg/step; mean translational error 0.37 mm; rotary motor torque 15.75 N·m/MPa as printed; pneumatic clamp 9 mm bore, 63 N/MPa; SNR loss < 2% (huang2022_pneumatic Abstract, Sec. II-III)
